1 percent per position and shared daily budget use equity excluding credit once

deposits and profits do not enlarge or replenish the daily loss budget
idempotent replay and permanent logical intent claim survive release
invalid evidence never becomes zero risk and invalidates the previous observation
all-in ticket risk includes costs exactly once and cannot omit them
an incomplete, duplicate or unexpected writer enrollment stays closed
actual TypeScript adapter calls the native PostgreSQL RPC contract
anonymous and authenticated clients cannot call or modify capacity state
real 12-session concurrency admits only the shared decimal capacity
simultaneous exact retry claims one operation and one permanent intent
waiting writer sees rollback with a real PostgreSQL row lock
repeatable-read snapshots are refused before admission and transition
submitted and unknown reservations cannot expire or release on a timeout
reconciliation requires a complete newer observation and accounted ticket or terminal proof

committed submission and permanent intent survive an immediate PostgreSQL restart
